settings.expectations.heading: Post-apply checks
settings.expectations.help: Expectations defined on a proxy host (its
settings.expectations.help_after: section) run right after every config sync. Choose what happens when one fails.
settings.expectations.rollback_help: Load the previous live config back into Caddy, pause automatic syncs for that server, and show a banner until you re-apply or keep the rolled-back config. Off = report only: results still appear on each host's health page and in the Activity log, but the new config stays live.
settings.general.activity_retention_help: Auto-delete activity log entries older than this many days. 0 keeps all entries.
settings.general.auto_sync_help: CaddyUI re-syncs all Caddy servers automatically when this many hours have passed since the last sync. Useful as a failsafe when cert renewals or external config changes need to be reapplied.
settings.general.color_theme_help: Independent of the light/dark toggle in the top bar — both can be combined (e.g. "dark + carbon orange"). Synced to your account, so it follows you across browsers and devices.
settings.general.fallback_html_help: Leave blank to use Caddy's default error response (CaddyUI's branded page on HTTPS for 404).
settings.general.fallback_html_hint: (optional — shown with the fallback status for requests matching no proxy, redirect or Advanced route)
settings.general.fallback_status_help: Answered for a request that matches no proxy host, redirection or Advanced route — on HTTP and HTTPS alike
settings.general.heading: General
settings.general.maintenance_active_3: — all proxy hosts are serving 503. Sync Caddy to apply.
settings.general.maintenance_help: When enabled, ALL proxy hosts immediately serve a 503 maintenance page regardless of individual host settings. Use for emergency maintenance windows. Applied on next sync.
settings.general.site_title_help: Shown in the browser tab title and sidebar. Leave blank to use "CaddyUI".
settings.general.strip_candidates_framin: (when you want to control framing via Content-Security-Policy
settings.general.strip_headers_help: CaddyUI deletes these response headers from every upstream's reply on every proxy host. Concatenated with each host's own
settings.general.themes_note: 5 available themes: Default Slate Blue, Carbon Orange, Forest Green, Rose / Crimson, and Deep Indigo. Saved on your user account
settings.general.themes_note_after: and applied on every device you sign into. Cached locally for instant paint on subsequent loads.
